question: Which plants could be cultivated successfully on Mars?
assessment: Conditional candidates for a protected greenhouse, supported by analog experiments. Not proof of actual-Mars success.

W2014.scope: Earth greenhouse, JSC-1A Mars simulant; 50-day pot trial
W2014.limitations: No actual-Mars validation; the 50-day endpoint does not establish harvest for all crops.

K2022.scope: Earth growth facility; crushed-basalt regolith analog
K2022.temperature: Follow source growth protocol; no crop-specific thermal response model fitted
K2022.treatment: Alfalfa amendment and fresh water; water-treatment experiments also reported
K2022.limitations: Perchlorate effects were not tested. Do not equate this basalt analog with untreated actual Mars regolith.

G2024.scope: Earth greenhouse; MMS-1; monocropping versus intercropping
G2024.treatment: Controlled water/nutrient protocol; compare cropping arrangements
G2024.limitations: Intercropping did not improve total yield in MMS-1 (RYT 0.93). Perchlorates and initial sterility were bypassed.

F2025.scope: Earth glasshouse; MMS-1 pure versus compost-amended substrates
F2025.temperature: Vegetative/flowering mean day/night 20.3/10.3 C; pod-filling 24.2/13.0 C
F2025.treatment: MMS-1:green compost 70:30 v/v, fertigation; cultivar Sfardella
F2025.limitations: Pure MMS-1 performed worse; cultivar and treatment specific. No mission-level validation.
